nodes.name: graphics.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the GraphicsProvider trait and GraphicsProviderMethods trait for abstracting OpenXR graphics backends (D3D11, etc.) with extension, format, session, and surface texture operations.

nodes.name: GraphicsProvider
nodes.summary: Marker struct/trait for selecting the active graphics provider implementation.

nodes.name: GraphicsProviderMethods
nodes.summary: Trait defining the graphics provider interface: enabling extensions, picking formats, creating sessions, and converting swapchain textures.

nodes.name: graphics_d3d11.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the GraphicsProviderMethods trait for Direct3D 11, providing D3D11-enabled OpenXR session creation and adapter enumeration with DXGI.
nodes.languageNotes: Platform-specific D3D11 implementation using DXGI adapter enumeration for OpenXR HMD rendering.

nodes.name: pick_format
nodes.summary: Selects the preferred D3D11 swapchain format from available formats, preferring BGRA8 over other variants.

nodes.name: create_session
nodes.summary: Creates an OpenXR D3D11 session by initializing a surfman adapter, connection, device, and wrapping the native D3D11 device.

nodes.name: surface_texture_from_swapchain_texture
nodes.summary: Wraps an OpenXR D3D11 texture into a surfman surface texture by wrapping the COM pointer.

nodes.name: get_matching_adapter
nodes.summary: Enumerates DXGI adapters to find one matching OpenXR adapter requirements using IDXGIAdapter1.

nodes.name: input.rs
nodes.summary: Implements OpenXR input handling: per-hand action sets for clicking, squeezing, button/axis states, hand tracking, and input source lifecycle with interaction profile bindings.

nodes.name: ClickState
nodes.summary: Finite state machine tracking click/squeeze state transitions between Clicking and Done states.

nodes.name: Frame
nodes.summary: Per-frame input snapshot containing the input frame data and select/squeeze/menu trigger states.

nodes.name: OpenXRInput
nodes.summary: Per-hand OpenXR input controller managing action spaces for aim/grip poses, click/squeeze actions, buttons, axes, hand tracking, and interaction profile bindings.

nodes.name: update_from_action
nodes.summary: Updates the click state from an OpenXR action state, transitioning through Clicking -> Done.

nodes.name: update_from_value
nodes.summary: Updates the click state from a raw float value and active flag, managing debounced transitions.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates an OpenXRInput for one hand: sets up pose, click, squeeze, button, and axis actions with interaction profile awareness.

nodes.name: setup_inputs
nodes.summary: Static method creating action sets, left/right OpenXRInput instances, generating bindings per interaction profile, and attaching action sets to the session.

nodes.name: get_bindings
nodes.summary: Generates OpenXR action bindings for a hand and interaction profile, mapping aim, grip, select, squeeze, and button/axis paths.

nodes.name: frame
nodes.summary: Generates per-frame input data: computes aim and grip poses, gaze direction, button/axis states, click/squeeze transitions, and optional hand joint tracking.

nodes.name: input_source
nodes.summary: Returns an input source descriptor indicating whether hand tracking is available.

nodes.name: pose_for
nodes.summary: Locates an action space pose relative to a base space and converts it to a rigid transform.

nodes.name: locate_hand
nodes.summary: Locates hand joint positions with optional aim state feedback from the Meta/FB hand tracking aim extension, building a HandJointPositions map.

nodes.name: interaction_profiles.rs
nodes.summary: Defines all known OpenXR interaction profile types (HTC Vive, Oculus Touch, Valve Index, etc.) and provides runtime profile lookup and supported-profile filtering based on enabled extensions.

nodes.name: InteractionProfileType
nodes.summary: Enumeration of all supported OpenXR interaction profile types including major VR controllers and hand tracking extensions.

nodes.name: InteractionProfile
nodes.summary: Describes an interaction profile with its type, OpenXR path, required extension, standard/left/right buttons and axes.

nodes.name: get_supported_interaction_profiles
nodes.summary: Filters known interaction profiles by checking if their required extensions are among the supported and enabled extension sets.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Core OpenXR integration module: instance creation, device discovery, session management, frame lifecycle, layer composition, input handling, and utility transforms for the Servo WebXR implementation.
nodes.languageNotes: Large OpenXR module using unsafe openxr crate bindings with extensive extension management and frame lifecycle coordination.

nodes.name: ContextMenuProvider
nodes.summary: Trait for providing an immersive context menu within the XR session.

nodes.name: ContextMenuFuture
nodes.summary: Trait representing a pollable async future for determining the context menu result.

nodes.name: ContextMenuResult
nodes.summary: Enum of context menu outcomes: ExitSession, Dismissed, or Pending.

nodes.name: AppInfo
nodes.summary: OpenXR application identity info including app/engine name and version.

nodes.name: ViewInfo
nodes.summary: Per-view cached state: raw openxr view, extent, and projection matrix.

nodes.name: OpenXrDiscovery
nodes.summary: Discovers OpenXR runtimes and creates XR sessions, managing instance creation and feature negotiation.

nodes.name: CreatedInstance
nodes.summary: Holds the initialized OpenXR instance and its capability flags: hand tracking support, secondary views, mutable FOV, passthrough, and framerate control.

nodes.name: OpenXrDevice
nodes.summary: Main OpenXR device implementation managing the session, frame waiter, layer manager, input actions, event handling, and camera views.

nodes.name: SharedData
nodes.summary: Thread-safe shared state for left/right/secondary views, blend modes, frame state, reference space, and swapchain sample count.

nodes.name: OpenXrLayerManager
nodes.summary: Manages OpenXR swapchain layers: creating/destroying layers, beginning frames with image acquisition, and ending frames with composition layer submission.

nodes.name: OpenXrLayer
nodes.summary: Wraps an OpenXR swapchain with depth-stencil texture and lazy-initialized surface textures.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates AppInfo with application and engine metadata.

nodes.name: set_view
nodes.summary: Stores a raw OpenXR view and recomputes the projection matrix for the given clip planes.

nodes.name: create_instance
nodes.summary: Creates and initializes an OpenXR instance with required extensions, interaction profiles, hand tracking support, and view configuration properties.

nodes.name: request_session
nodes.summary: Requests an OpenXR session: checks feature support, creates an instance, validates required features, and spawns an OpenXrDevice.

nodes.name: supports_session
nodes.summary: Checks if a session mode is supported by testing instance creation and environment blend mode availability.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates an OpenXrLayerManager with session, shared data, frame stream, a clearer, and optional passthrough support.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Creates an OpenXrLayer by enumerating swapchain images and initializing surface texture storage.

nodes.name: get_surface_texture
nodes.summary: Retrieves or creates a surfman surface texture from an OpenXR swapchain image index.

nodes.name: create_layer
nodes.summary: Creates an OpenXR swapchain layer: picks a format, creates the swapchain, sets up depth-stencil texture, and registers the layer.

nodes.name: destroy_layer
nodes.summary: Destroys an OpenXR layer: cleans up the clearer, removes tracking, and destroys surface textures and GL resources.

nodes.name: end_frame
nodes.summary: Ends an OpenXR frame: releases swapchain images, builds primary and secondary composition layer projection views, and submits them via end_frame or end_secondary.

nodes.name: begin_frame
nodes.summary: Begins an OpenXR frame: acquires and waits for swapchain images, retrieves surface textures, builds sub-image descriptions, and clears buffers.

nodes.name: image_rect
nodes.summary: Converts a WebXR viewport Rect to an OpenXR swapchain sub-image Rect.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs the main OpenXrDevice: creates the session, layer manager, sets up reference spaces, view configurations, blend modes, swapchain sample count, and input action sets via OpenXRInput.

nodes.name: handle_openxr_events
nodes.summary: Polls and processes OpenXR events: session state changes (ready, sync, focus loss), interaction profile changes, and reference space changes.

nodes.name: viewports
nodes.summary: Computes viewport rectangles for left, right, and secondary eyes from the native view extents.

nodes.name: begin_animation_frame
nodes.summary: Main per-frame update: polls events, handles context menus, waits for frame, locates views, syncs actions, generates input frames, fires select/input events, and returns the frame update.

nodes.name: quit
nodes.summary: Gracefully exits the XR session: requests exit, drains remaining events, ends the session, and notifies the event callback.

nodes.name: environment_blend_mode
nodes.summary: Returns the current environment blend mode from shared data.

nodes.name: update_frame_rate
nodes.summary: Requests a new display refresh rate from the OpenXR session.

nodes.name: reference_space_bounds
nodes.summary: Queries and converts OpenXR reference space bounds into a list of boundary points.

nodes.name: surfman_layer_manager.rs
nodes.summary: Implements a surfman-based layer manager for WebXR sessions, handling layer creation/destruction, framebuffer management, and per-frame swapchain acquisition and presentation.

nodes.name: SurfmanLayerManager
nodes.summary: Manages WebXR layers using surfman swapchains: tracks layers, swap chains, surface textures, depth-stencil textures, viewports, and a clearer.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a SurfmanLayerManager with viewports, swap chains, and initializes the GlClearer.

nodes.name: create_layer
nodes.summary: Creates a new WebXR layer: generates a depth-stencil texture, creates a detached swapchain, registers the layer, and returns the layer ID.

nodes.name: destroy_layer
nodes.summary: Destroys a layer: cleans up the clearer, removes swap chain, surface textures, depth-stencil textures, and deletes the OpenGL texture.

nodes.name: begin_frame
nodes.summary: Begins a frame by acquiring surface textures for each layer, setting up sub-images with color/depth-stencil textures, and clearing the buffers.

nodes.name: end_frame
nodes.summary: Ends a frame by flushing GL, recycling surface textures, and swapping buffers for each layer.
